standards.title: Drinking Water — Specification (Second Revision)
standards.qco_title: Packaged Drinking Water Quality Control Order
standards.qco_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs & FSSAI Mandate
standards.description_plain: Prescribes essential physical, chemical, and microbiological limits for safe drinking water to protect public health against heavy metals, pesticide residues, and microbial pathogens.
key_testing_parameters: Heavy metal thresholds (Lead, Cadmium, Arsenic, Mercury)
Pesticide residues (individual max 0.0001 mg/l, total max 0.0005 mg/l)
Total Dissolved Solids (TDS, max 500 mg/l desirable) and pH (6.5 to 8.5)

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
standards.qco_title: Packaged Drinking Water Mandatory Certification Scheme
standards.qco_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
standards.description_plain: Mandatory standard for commercial water packaging facilities, reverse osmosis bottling plants, and 20L water jar distributors in India.

standards.title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts — Fineness and Marking
standards.qco_title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order
standards.description_plain: Specifies legal fineness grades (14K, 18K, 20K, 22K, 23K, 24K) and mandates the 3-mark hallmark format with unique 6-digit HUID code.
recommended_labs: BIS Recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHCs) across India

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders — Specification
standards.qco_title: Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order
standards.qco_ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
standards.description_plain: Mandatory standard for motorcycle helmets ensuring high shock absorption and visor resistance to protect rider safety.
key_testing_parameters: Impact attenuation test at high (+50C) and low (-10C) temperatures
Chin strap dynamic retention and release force
Visor optical distortion and scratch resistance
Weight restriction (max 1.2 kg to prevent rider fatigue)

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes (Lithium Systems)
standards.product_name: Lithium-ion Batteries, Power Banks & Battery Packs
standards.qco_title: Compulsory Registration Scheme for Secondary Batteries
standards.qco_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
standards.description_plain: CRS safety standard ensuring secondary cells and batteries prevent thermal runaway, swelling, and internal short-circuits.
